proposal.reason: Main change is RAS/hang diagnostics: new Ring backtrace attribution, richer diag wire/snapshot formats, offline replay/summary/report logic, and communicator-scoped diag selection to locate mid-kernel forwarding stalls. Added enqueue because it introduces substantive runtime-side operation identity capture (per-work seqNumber/workOffset tagging during task append/scheduling) that RAS now depends on for cross-rank Ring attribution correctness.
